info.name: Affirm Checkout Authorization Transaction Events API

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return per page.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor returned from a previous list response.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of transaction event records for the authenticated merchant. Each event documents a change in a transaction's lifecycle, such as an authorization, capture, refund, or void. Events include timestamps, amounts, fees, and reference identifiers for reconciliation.
